battle.name: 管崇起義
battle.brief: 大業九年八月癸卯，晉陵人管崇與吳郡朱燮聚眾十萬餘，自稱將軍，寇掠江左；隋遣吐萬緒、魚俱羅討之不能剋，遂迎餘杭劉元進據吳郡稱天子。管崇屯毘陵連營百餘里，敗保黃山，眾潰被斬。卡面亞述長矛未至此役，然其短柄長刃配鐵鏃的近身刺擊邏輯，可與江南水網舟船、隋營制式器械相對照。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的兩方，力量對比極不對稱。隋朝一方是完整運作的中央國家：京師十二衛與諸軍府之外，江南一線的實際守備是州郡兵與縣兵，以及大業九年正月新置的折衝、果毅、武勇、雄武等郎將官所領的驍果。隋煬帝其時在涿郡準備又一次東征高句麗，東都以越王侗與民部尚書樊子蓋留守，江北的江都與揚子一線只由虎牙郎將趙六兒率兵一萬人分作五營屯守，專為防備南賊而設。起義一方沒有任何官府編制，是江南鄉民自發聚集的武裝：吳郡朱燮本是還俗道人、昆山縣博士，與數十名學生起兵，鄉里苦於役使的人聞風歸附；晉陵管崇隱居常熟，長大美姿容、志氣倜儻，自言有王者相，群盜遂相與奉之。眾數由數萬膨脹至十萬餘，自稱將軍，隨後把餘杭人劉元進迎為共主，據吳郡稱天子，朱燮與管崇自署尚書僕射、署置百官。江南地方勢力亦大量響應，毘陵、東陽、會稽、建安一帶的豪傑紛紛執持本地長吏以應，說明起義並非孤立的鄉民暴動，而是與江南既有政治矛盾的結合。
countriesEn: The two sides were badly mismatched in strength. On the Sui side stood a fully functioning central state: besides the twelve guards and the army headquarters of the capital, the actual garrison of the lower Yangtze consisted of prefectural and county troops, together with the braves led by the newly created offices of paladins of the square, fruit and of the warrior bands, established in the first month of the ninth year of Daye. The emperor was then at Zhuojun preparing yet another expedition against Goguryeo, and the eastern capital was held by Prince Tong and the Minister of Revenue Fan Zigan; on the northern bank of the river, the line of Jiangdu and Yangzi was guarded by a single officer, the tiger-toothed lieutenant Zhao Liuer, with ten thousand men divided into five camps, posted there expressly to hold off the southern bandits. The insurgents had no administrative apparatus of any kind: they were armed villagers of the lower Yangtze who had gathered on their own. Zhu Xie of Wu commandery had been a monk returned to lay life and a county schoolmaster, and rose with a few dozen of his students, and the villagers, exhausted by corvee, flocked to him. Guan Chong of Jinling, living in retirement at Changshu, tall and handsome of bearing, of high spirit, claimed the physiognomy of a king, and the bands of outlaws accordingly bore him their allegiance. Their numbers grew from a few thousands to more than a hundred thousand; they called themselves generals, and then brought in Liu Yuanjin of Yuhang as their common sovereign, established themselves at Wu commandery and proclaimed him emperor, while Zhu Xie and Guan Chong took for themselves the office of directors of the ministry and set up a full administration. Many local powers answered the rising: in the districts of Piling, Dongyang, Kuaiji and Jian'an, men of standing seized the local magistrates and joined in, which shows that this was not an isolated peasant rising but a revolt fused with the standing political grievance of the lower Yangtze.
people: 史書留名者，以晉陵管崇與吳郡朱燮為首。管崇自述有王者相，群盜奉之為主，兵起後遣其將陸顗渡江，夜襲趙六兒屯楊子的五營，破了其中兩營，盡取其器械軍資，眾由是益盛。吳郡朱燮則是還俗道人，涉獵經史、頗知兵法，原任昆山縣博士，起兵之初只帶數十學生，全靠鄉里苦役者響應而成軍。真正的共主是餘杭人劉元進，此人手長尺餘、臂垂過膝，自以相貌非常，早有異志；大業九年七月聞楊玄感起兵，便在餘杭舉兵，旬月間眾至數萬。八月管崇、朱燮響應劉元進，十月大業九年，迎之共主江左，據吳郡稱天子，朱燮、管崇俱為尚書僕射。隋方與之對陣的名將是左屯衛大將軍代人吐萬緒與光祿大夫下邽人魚俱羅；屯守揚子的是虎牙郎將趙六兒。鎮壓此役最關鍵的人物其實是江都郡丞王世充：他以江都萬餘人擊破起義軍，採用焚香立誓、不殺降者的辦法招散卒歸首，旬月之間散者略盡，繼而渡江追擊，終將劉元進、朱燮逼死於吳。隋煬帝本人遠在涿郡與遼東，自始至始終未直接介入江南戰事。
peopleEn: The names history preserved run to Guan Chong of Jinling and Zhu Xie of Wu commandery. Guan Chong claimed the physiognomy of a king and the bands of outlaws bore him their allegiance; once the rising was under way he sent his commander Lu Yi across the river and attacked at night the five camps of Zhao Liuer at Yangzi, breaking two of them and taking all the arms and stores they held, after which his numbers grew yet further. Zhu Xie of Wu had been a monk returned to lay life, well read in the classics and histories and not ignorant of military art, and was by trade a county schoolmaster at Kunshan; he began the rising with a few dozen of his students and built his force entirely out of villagers worn down by corvee. The real sovereign was Liu Yuanjin of Yuhang, a man whose hands were more than a chi long and whose arms hung below his knees, who fancied that his appearance marked him out and had long harboured such designs; in the seventh month of the ninth year of Daye, on hearing that Yang Xuangan had risen, he raised a revolt at Yuhang and gathered tens of thousands within ten days. In the eighth month Guan Chong and Zhu Xie answered Liu Yuanjin, and in the tenth month they welcomed him as their common lord, set themselves at Wu commandery and proclaimed him emperor, with Zhu Xie and Guan Chong both taking the title of directors of the ministry. The Sui commanders who faced them were the Left Colonel of the Vanguard, Tu Wanxu, a man of the Dai tribe, and the Director of the Palace of Lightly Invested, Yu Juluo, a native of Xia. The officer holding Yangzi was the tiger-toothed lieutenant Zhao Liuer. The man who in fact proved decisive was Wang Shichong, the deputy magistrate of Jiangdu: he broke the insurgents with some ten thousand men raised in Jiangdu, and used the device of burning incense and swearing before the image that those who surrendered would not be harmed, so that within a month the scattered bands came in almost to a man; he then crossed the river in pursuit and drove Liu Yuanjin and Zhu Xie to their deaths in the district of Wu. The emperor himself remained far away at Zhuojun and in Liaodong and never intervened in the fighting in the south.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長矛並不出現在六一三年的江南，它是兩河流域的兵器：短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃，與弓、斧及種種鐵器成套使用，亞述人靠著這一套組合把兩河流域的城一個接一個打下。把它放進這場戰役的裝備表，是因為它恰好代表「國家壟斷冶鐵與供應的制式近戰兵器」這一端，而六一三年江南的兩邊，一端完全沒有這一端。起義軍初起時手中只有削尖的竹木與順手可得的農具，談不上任何制式兵器的供應；真正改變雙方實力差距的，是破楊子兩營時繳獲的那批「器械軍資」——隋軍的制式器械落入叛軍之手，眾數才從數萬膨脹到十萬餘，這正是《資治通鑑》所記「收其器械軍資而去，眾益盛」的實質。隋方則是弩、槊、直刃刀、漆皮盾與明光鎧一類的成套配備，靠折衝、果毅等郎將分領驍果編制，屯紮在楊子五營這樣的據點上；水網地形的江南還牽涉舟船與水軍，跨江夜襲、渡水追擊都是水網決定的動作。亞述長矛的真正教訓正在這裡：亞述人能逐城攻破，靠的不是某一件長矛，而是長矛、弓、攻城器械與冶鐵供應被編在同一套體制之內；六一三年江南的兩方，一方有體制而無制式兵器可恃，另一方連體制也沒有，卻靠一次夜襲繳獲，把制式器械變成自己的。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card did not appear in the lower Yangtze in 613. It belongs to the equipment of the two river lands: short haft, long blade, iron point, wielded together with the bow, the axe and a variety of iron implements, and it was by that combination that the Assyrians took the cities of Mesopotamia one after another. It belongs in the equipment table of this rising because it happens to stand for one extreme, that of the standardised close-combat weapon whose supply is monopolised by the state, and the two sides in the lower Yangtze in 613 stood at opposite extremes on that scale. When the insurgents rose they had only sharpened bamboo and wood and whatever farm tools came to hand, and no supply of standard weapons at all. What truly shifted the balance between the two sides was the batch of arms and stores captured when two camps at Yangzi were broken: the Sui's standard equipment falling into the insurgents' hands was what carried their numbers from a few thousands to more than a hundred thousand, and this is the substance of what the Zizhi Tongjian records when it says that they took the arms and stores of the camp and their multitude increased the more. On the Sui side the equipment was the standard set of crossbows, long spears, straight-edged sabres, lacquered wooden shields and bright armour, distributed among braves commanded by paladins of the square and of the fruit, and posted at points such as the five camps at Yangzi. The water network of the lower Yangtze also brought in boats and river troops, and the crossing of the river by night and the pursuit across the water were movements dictated by that network. The true lesson of the Assyrian spear lies here: the Assyrians took city after city not because of any single spear but because the spear, the bow, the siege engines and the supply of iron were organised into one single system. In the lower Yangtze in 613 one side had the system but no standard weapons to draw on, and the other had not even the system, yet won through a single night raid that turned standard equipment into its own.
tactics: 起義軍的戰法是典型的鄉民流動戰。陸顗率眾夜渡，掩襲揚子五營，憑的是水網、夜間與突然，而不是攻城器械；得手之後不據城、不戍守，帶著繳獲的器械軍資轉戰各郡，「寇掠江左」而不佔領固定的城池。到十月劉元進被迎為共主、署置百官之後，才第一次具備了政治目標，部眾依舊分作多股，以毘陵為大本營連營百餘里，東陽、會稽一帶的響應者各守本地，形成多點同時起、互為聲援的樣子。官軍的處置則集中於三處：一是吐萬緒自北方濟江，先在丹楊擊破劉元進之軍，再進屯曲阿，與結柵自守的劉元進相持百餘日，迫其自潰；二是乘勝攻毘陵，破了連營百餘里的管崇部；三是圍其退保的黃山，終於斬管崇及其將卒五千餘人，解會稽之圍。這條攻守線的成敗，關鍵不在兵力而在指揮：魚俱羅曾以賊非歲月可平、諸子又在洛京為由，潛遣家僕迎之，隋煬帝聞之大怒，諸將希旨奏吐萬緒怯懦，魚俱羅敗衄被坐斬，吐萬緒憂憤道卒；接任的江都郡丞王世充改弦更張，募江都萬餘人，擊破之餘則歸功於下、軍實盡推士卒，又以焚香立誓保證不殺來降者，使散在山林水鄉的餘眾在旬月之間歸首略盡，再渡江掃蕩戰殘。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents were those of a fluid peasant war. Lu Yi led them across the river by night to fall on the five camps at Yangzi, and what carried the assault was the water network, the darkness and surprise rather than any siege engine; having taken the camp they did not hold a city or garrison it, but moved on through the commanderies with the captured arms and stores, raiding the country east of the river without seizing any fixed seat. Only in the tenth month, when Liu Yuanjin was welcomed as their common lord and a set of offices was set up, did the movement acquire a political aim; even then the force remained split into several bodies, with the main camp at Piling drawn out over a hundred li, and the responses in Dongyang and Kuaiji each holding their own ground, so that the rising started at many points at once and supported itself. The official response was concentrated on three moves. First, Tu Wanxu came down from the north and crossed the river, breaking Liu Yuanjin's army at Danyang and then taking up a position at Qu'a, where he stood for a hundred days against Liu Yuanjin, who had closed his camp with palisades, until the insurgents broke of their own accord. Second, riding on that success, he attacked Piling and broke the camp of Guan Chong, drawn out over a hundred li. Third, he surrounded the position to which they retired at Huangshan, and at last took Guan Chong and more than five thousand of his officers and men, and lifted the siege of Kuaiji. What decided this line of attack and defence was command, not numbers. Yu Juluo had held that the bandits could not be settled in a matter of months and that his sons were still in the western capital, and had secretly sent a servant to fetch them; the emperor heard of it and was furious, the officers then charged Tu Wanxu with cowardice out of deference to the throne, Yu Juluo was defeated in an engagement and put to death, and Tu Wanxu died of grief on the journey. His successor, Wang Shichong, the deputy magistrate of Jiangdu, changed the method entirely: he raised some ten thousand men in Jiangdu, gave the credit for each success to his subordinates and handed the captured stores to the soldiers, and further burned incense and swore that those who came in would not be killed, so that the remnants scattered among the woods and waterways of the delta came in within a month, almost to a man; he then crossed the river and swept up what was left of them.
data: 可核對的數字分四類。制度與編制類：大業九年正月丁丑，隋廷「徵天下兵，募民為驍果，集于涿郡」，同日「置折衝、果毅、武勇、雄武等郎將官，以領驍果」，同年八月又「制驍果之家蠲免賦役」，說明此役官軍一面以募兵填補府兵崩解後的空缺，一面給予新募者家屬免賦的優惠。兵力類：起義眾數，《隋書》作「擁眾十萬餘」，《隋書·王充傳》作「十餘萬」；劉元進七月起兵旬月間至數萬；楊玄感六月在黎陽舉兵眾亦十餘萬；隋方屯揚子者為虎牙郎將趙六兒所部兵一萬人，分為五營，陸顗一役破其兩營。距離與時間類：吐萬緒自北方濟江，先破丹楊，進屯曲阿，與劉元進結柵相持百餘日；又破毘陵連營百餘里，賊退保黃山，圍而殲之，斬管崇及其將卒五千餘人——《通鑑》將此戰置於大業九年十二月之後、《隋書》則記「連年不能剋」，故戰役實跨大業九年冬與十年初。作戰背景類：大業八年冬隋軍大舉東征，詔書自記「總一百一十三萬三千八百，號二百萬，其餽運者倍之」；大業九年正月再徵天下兵，而三吳兵家多已亡命。需說明的是，此役的細帳多不可考：管崇部的分營編制、各式器械數量、兩軍逐日傷亡與糧秣消耗，《隋書》《資治通鑑》皆不載，僅存眾數與斬獲數字，故文中凡涉細部只宜作量級推想，不宜坐實。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked fall into four kinds. Institutional and organisational: in the first month of the ninth year of Daye, on the dingchou day, the court mustered troops from throughout the realm and recruited the people as braves, assembling them at Zhuojun, and on the same day created the offices of paladins of the square, of the fruit, and of the warrior and mighty bands to command the braves; in the eighth month of the same year it further remitted the corvee and taxes of the families of the braves, which shows that the government on the one side filled the gap left by the collapse of the fubing with recruited men, and on the other gave those men's households exemption and preferential treatment. Numbers of men: for the insurgents the Zizhi Tongjian has the crowd swelling to more than a hundred thousand, and the Shu of Sui in the biography of Wang Shichong has it at some hundred thousand odd; Liu Yuanjin drew tens of thousands within ten days of rising in the seventh month; Yang Xuangan raised more than a hundred thousand at Liyang in the sixth month. On the government side the force at Yangzi was the ten thousand men of the tiger-toothed lieutenant Zhao Liuer, divided into five camps, of which Lu Yi broke two in a single night. Distances and durations: Tu Wanxu crossed the river from the north, first breaking Liu Yuanjin at Danyang, then taking up position at Qu'a, where he stood for more than a hundred days against Liu Yuanjin, who had closed himself in with palisades; he then broke the camp at Piling drawn out over a hundred li; the insurgents retired to Huangshan and were surrounded there, Guan Chong and more than five thousand of his officers and men being taken; the Zizhi Tongjian places this last action after the twelfth month of the ninth year of Daye, while the Shu of Sui records that the two commanders could not subdue them for years, so that the campaign in truth straddled the winter of the ninth year and the opening of the tenth. For the wider setting: in the winter of the eighth year the Sui mustered a great expedition eastward, and the edict itself records a total of 1,133,800 men, proclaimed as two million, with the transport of supplies doubled on top; in the first month of the ninth year there was a fresh levy of the whole realm, and many families in the Three Wu had already fled. It must be said that the detailed accounts of this campaign cannot be recovered: the divisional organisation of Guan Chong's force, the numbers of each kind of implement, the daily casualties of either army and the consumption of grain are not recorded in either the Shu of Sui or the Zizhi Tongjian, and only the size of the crowds and the numbers taken survive. Any statement about finer detail should therefore be treated as an estimate of magnitude and not pinned down.
cause: 起義的成因有四層。其一是役使與兵役：隋煬帝連年東征，大業九年再發三吳之兵，《資治通鑑》記三吳士卒相語曰：「往歲天下全盛，吾輩父兄征高麗者猶太半不返；今已罷弊，復為此行，吾屬無遺類矣！」於是亡命者雲集，郡縣捕之愈急，逃亡者反得聚為部眾。其二是直接導火線：大業九年六月禮部尚書楊玄感反於黎陽，眾至十餘萬；八月壬寅宇文述等破之於閿鄉，斬之，餘黨悉平，而次日癸卯江左即起兵響應——兩地相距千里而響應在一日之內，說明起義所需的不是籌劃而是示範。其三是中央的注意力與兵力全在北方：煬帝屯涿郡、備高句麗，東都僅留越王侗與樊子蓋，江南只靠楊子五營一萬人，北強南虛的結構使一次得手就能擴散。其四是江南自身的政治矛盾：朱燮以還俗道人、縣學博士起兵而應者雲集，管崇以「王者相」之說得群盜推戴，說明江南對隋廷的統治已有相當的不信任；而毘陵、東陽、會稽、建安豪傑「多執長吏以應」，更把地方士族與官僚的矛盾拉進了這場叛亂。至於官軍屢戰不克的原因，不在兵少，而在帥府與朝廷互相掣肘：諸將屢請寬限，朝廷不許，逼出一場連年不能下江南的消耗戰。
causeEn: The causes of the rising work at four levels. First, corvee and military service: the emperor had marched east year upon year, and in the ninth year of Daye the Three Wu were levied again. The Zizhi Tongjian records the soldiers of the Three Wu saying among themselves that in the years when the realm was at its fullest, of their fathers and elder brothers who went to Goguryeo scarcely half ever came back, and that now they were worn out and the same march was to be made again, so that not one of them would survive; runaways then flocked together, the more the officials hunted them the more they fled, and fugitives found themselves able to gather into bands. Second, the immediate trigger: in the sixth month of the ninth year of Daye the Minister of rites Yang Xuangan rose at Liyang with more than a hundred thousand men; on the renyin day of the eighth month Yuwen Shu and the rest broke him at Guanxiang and beheaded him and his remnant was scattered, and on the very next day, the guichou day, the rising in the country east of the river began. That two places a thousand li apart should answer one another within a single day shows that what the rising needed was not preparation but example. Third, the attention and the troops of the centre were all in the north: the emperor was at Zhuojun readying himself for Goguryeo, the eastern capital was held by Prince Tong and Fan Zigan alone, and in the south there was nothing but Zhao Liuer's five camps of ten thousand men, so that a strong north and a weak south let one success spread. Fourth, there were political contradictions of their own in the lower Yangtze. Zhu Xie rose as a monk returned to lay life and a county schoolmaster and drew the people of the districts, who were exhausted by service, while Guan Chong was borne aloft by the bands of outlaws on the strength of his claim to the physiognomy of a king, all of which shows how far the trust of the lower Yangtze in Sui rule had already decayed; and the seizure of local magistrates by men of standing at Piling, Dongyang, Kuaiji and Jian'an drew the quarrel of the local elite and the officials into the revolt. As for why the government could not take the province, the reason is not a shortage of men but the friction between the commanders and the throne: the generals asked again and again for time, the throne refused, and out of it came a war of attrition that could not be finished in the lower Yangtze for years running.
impact: 這場起義在當時並不顯眼——十餘萬眾、兩年而平，史書只以數十字記之——但它留下的痕跡極深。第一，它第一次暴露隋朝在江南的崩解速度：八月癸卯起兵、十月據吳郡稱天子、十月即遣大將，江南郡縣響應者眾，中央的處置卻只能靠一連串更換的將帥應付，說明地方一旦揭旗，中央已無能力就地平定。第二，它把「鄉民起義可以升格為政權」這件事在江南落了實：朱燮、管崇自署尚書僕射、署置百官，劉元進稱天子，雖然十餘日而敗，卻是隋末江南諸割據勢力（江都的王世充、吳郡的沈法興、會稽的汪文進一系）共同援引的先例。第三，它加速了隋廷的自我毀滅：平叛所用的手段是籍沒賊屬之家、誅抑降者、猜忌將帥，魚俱羅因私遣家僕迎子而被坐斬、吐萬緒憂憤道卒，朝廷於是自己拆了自己的柱石；江南的人心並未因此歸順，反而記住了官軍反覆失信。第四，在軍制上，此役是府兵崩解、募兵補位而仍不足以應付的實證：大業九年正月新置折衝、果毅等郎將以領驍果，正是為了應付這類到處蜂起的叛亂，結果仍舊屢戰不能克，隋朝在制度上的補救速度，遠落後於亂事發生的速度。
impactEn: At the time this rising attracted little notice; a hundred thousand men, settled within two years, and the histories record it in a few dozen characters. Yet the traces it left run deep. First, it revealed for the first time how swiftly Sui control in the lower Yangtze was coming apart: the rising began on the guichou day of the eighth month, in the tenth month a sovereign was proclaimed at Wu commandery, and in that same tenth month generals were dispatched, while the commanderies of the region answered in numbers, and the court's only reply was a string of commanders posted one after another, each replacing the last. Once a district raised its flag the centre could no longer pacify it on the spot. Second, it established in the lower Yangtze the fact that a rising of villagers could be raised to the status of a government. Zhu Xie and Guan Chong took the title of directors of the ministry and set up an administration, and Liu Yuanjin proclaimed himself emperor; though the venture was over in a matter of weeks, it became the precedent invoked by every later separatist power of the region, from Wang Shichong at Jiangdu to Shen Faxing at Wu and the line of Wang Wenjin at Kuaiji. Third, it hastened the destruction of the Sui: the means used to end it were the confiscation of the property of rebels' households, the killing of those who had surrendered, and the suspicion of commanders, so that Yu Juluo was put to death for secretly sending a servant to fetch his sons and Tu Wanxu died of grief on the road, and the throne pulled down its own pillars; the people of the lower Yangtze were not brought back to loyalty by this but remembered instead how often the government had broken its word. Fourth, in military terms this campaign is the proof that the collapse of the fubing and the substitution of recruited braves were not enough: the new offices of paladins of the square and of the fruit created in the first month of the ninth year of Daye were made precisely to answer risings of this kind, and they could not take the province even so, which shows that the speed at which the Sui repaired its institutions was far slower than the speed at which trouble broke out.
result: 結局是起義軍的失敗，但敗得不乾淨。大業九年冬末，吐萬緒自北濟江，於丹楊擊破劉元進之軍，進屯曲阿，與結柵自守的劉元進相持百餘日，賊眾終於自潰；吐萬緒乘勝攻毘陵，破了管崇連營百餘里的大本營，賊退保黃山，隋軍圍之，於陳斬管崇及其將卒五千餘人，會稽之圍遂解。首領管崇於此役伏誅，眾則星散。戰後朝廷並未罷手：吐萬緒請休兵待來春不獲准，魚俱羅以「賊非歲月可平」且私遣家僕迎子，兩人相繼被疑貶，魚俱羅坐斬，吐萬緒憂憤道卒；朝廷改命江都郡丞王世充發淮南兵數萬討劉元進。王世充到任，募江都萬餘人，擊破之後歸功於下、軍實盡推士卒，又在通玄寺瑞像前焚香立誓，約降者不殺，旬月之間散者歸首略盡，繼而渡江追擊，劉元進、朱燮敗死於吳，餘眾或降或散。就軍事結果而言，隋朝平定了江南，楊玄感、劉元進、管崇、朱燮這條線上的江左勢力被逐一擊破，隋廷在長江下游重獲一個安寧的前方；但就政治結果而言，這個安寧是靠將帥被殺、帥將道死、降卒被坑、賊屬家產被籍沒換來的，江南並未因此歸心。隋朝平得了戰場，平不了人心，而大業十年之後江南再亂、杜伏威等部崛起，正是這次平叛留下的真空。
resultEn: The outcome was a defeat for the insurgents, but not a clean one. In the last winter of the ninth year of Daye Tu Wanxu came down from the north across the river, broke Liu Yuanjin's army at Danyang and took up position at Qu'a, where for more than a hundred days he faced Liu Yuanjin, who had closed himself in behind palisades, until the insurgents finally broke of their own accord; riding on that success he attacked Piling and broke the great camp of Guan Chong, drawn out over a hundred li; the insurgents retired to Huangshan, the Sui troops surrounded them, and there at Chen Guan Chong and more than five thousand of his officers and men were taken, and the siege of Kuaiji was thereby lifted. Guan Chong, the leader, was executed on the field, and the rest of his force scattered. The court did not stop there. Tu Wanxu's request to halt and wait until spring was refused; Yu Juluo, who held that the bandits could not be settled in a matter of months and who had secretly sent a servant to fetch his sons, was removed and then put to death, and Tu Wanxu died of grief on the road. The throne then turned to Wang Shichong, deputy magistrate of Jiangdu, ordering him to raise some tens of thousands of men from Huainan against Liu Yuanjin. Wang Shichong took over, raised some ten thousand in Jiangdu, gave the credit for his successes to his men and handed them the captured stores, and then burned incense before the image of the sacred statue in the Tongxuan temple and swore that those who surrendered would not be killed; within a month the scattered men came in almost to a man, and he then crossed the river in pursuit, Liu Yuanjin and Zhu Xie falling in the district of Wu, the rest surrendering or scattering. In military terms the Sui had pacified the lower Yangtze: the line of Yang Xuangan, Liu Yuanjin, Guan Chong and Zhu Xie was broken one by one, and the court regained a quiet forward position on the lower river. In political terms, however, that quiet was bought with the deaths of its own generals, the killing of those who had surrendered, the confiscation of the property of rebels' households and the dispersal of the survivors, and the lower Yangtze was not brought back to loyalty by any of it. The Sui could pacify the battlefield and could not pacify the people, and the renewed trouble in the south after the tenth year of Daye, with the rise of bands such as Du Fuwei's, grew precisely out of the vacuum this pacification left behind.
